text:
Leah Park: Heads-up — Northbridge Health wants an on-prem POC in a sealed datacenter. They require zero-egress, USB transfer okay, and an approved patch cadence. Need a short preflight checklist and pricing exception ask.

Devon Kim: Do we have a standard pricing uplift for sealed/offline installs? customer expects T&M for install + monthly premium.

Leah Park: We usually do a 20% uplift on Dedicated list for sealed deployments + a one-time POC engineering fee. @finance will confirm, but flagging now.

Ravi Singh: Tech Qs: how do we handle signed bundles and hotfixes? are delta bundles supported for sneakernet?

Priya Nair: From security side: they insist on HSM-backed signing and offline attestation. Also request SBOM and model provenance. Legal will want export-control note.

Leah Park: Notes — For this POC we can do: USB-delivered immutable bundle with signature verification via customer HSM using our public key. Hotfixes via signed delta blobs. Patch cadence options: quarterly (default) or monthly with surcharge.

Devon Kim: Is activation token required onsite? they asked about offline license activation without internet.

Ravi Singh: Yes, we support offline activation: generate signed activation token from Console, customer applies locally. It requires ops approval and signed SLA.

Priya Nair: Checklist items we need to provide to customer: SBOM, bundle signature chain, offline activation steps, HSM public key format, operator runbook, rollback steps, and a timeline for security review.

Leah Park: Quick runbook snippet to share with them:

```
- Deliver: bundle.tar.gz + bundle.tar.gz.sig + sbom.json
- Onsite: copy to host, verify signature against provided pubkey
- Activate: run `redwood activate --token <signed-token>`
- Verify: `redwood status` -> model versions + hash
```

Devon Kim: Can we allow a 30-day POC window with limited support (email + async) vs paid onsite? they asked for quick timeline.

Leah Park: We can do 30-day trial if customer agrees to no SLA and no guaranteed upgrades in-trial. For production they must sign sealed deployment SOW for support and patch cadence.

Ravi Singh: One operational blocker: sealed DC ops want deterministic image size and no dynamic downloads. We need to confirm our runtime doesn't pull weights at first boot.

Priya Nair: Also add: clarify telemetry — they require telemetry disabled by default for sealed installs. Must include opt-in instructions.

Leah Park: Action items: 1) @Devon confirm pricing uplift + POC eng fee, 2) @Ravi prepare minimal bundle manifest and delta patch process, 3) @Priya draft security checklist + SBOM template. I'll craft a short one-pager for customer handoff.

ops-bot: New ticket created: SLS-2248 "Northbridge sealed POC — pricing + tech preflight" assigned to Devon, Ravi, Priya.

Devon Kim: Acked, will take pricing and commercial wording.

Ravi Singh: I'll prototype a 1.2GB minimal bundle and confirm no runtime egress during boot. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya Nair: Drafting security checklist now, will include HSM formats (PKCS#11 + PEM), SBOM example, and export-control note.

Leah Park: Thanks — target to send customer preflight package by Wednesday COB. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup: 

Devon Kim: pinging @finance privately for uplift verification.

Leah Park: closing thread in a day unless new blockers.
